paragraphs: An independent, open-source 3D texture painting application in the spirit of Substance Painter, written in Rust. Paint directly on 3D models with layered PBR materials, masks, generators and smart materials, bake mesh maps, and export game-ready textures.

v0.1.4: the green Check / update button downloads, installs and restarts future desktop releases with your unsaved project restored. Versions through v0.1.3 need one download to get the button. See the changelog.
New here? Follow the illustrated getting-started guide. A welcome screen and six-step in-app guide are available in the browser and included in the next desktop release.
features: Welcome and quick start (next desktop release): open a model/project, try the sample, see what's new, or follow
the six-step guide from Help. Desktop recent files make it easy to resume; the startup screen can be turned off on the welcome screen or in Preferences. The hub fits narrow windows.
Layer stack: paint layers, fill layers (uniform, procedural, image and mesh-map sources) and
folders, with 32 blend modes and opacity per channel. Right-click a layer to duplicate, delete or save it to your library.
Layer tree editing (next desktop release): drag a layer's name or row above/below another
